The project is an exact copy of the retained `floating_reference_J17qcd`
source (SHA-256 in `sha256.json`). It defines two PEC pads and one FLOAT
differential feed in a closed air box. The registered power-wave regression
uses current public solves to check the R/X/L/C reference, independent
terminal wave equations, calibration voltage/current transfer and physical
current maps. This fixture removes a dependency on ignored local data.

This source capture alone does not certify native-response agreement or
continuum accuracy. The regression does not run the native engine.
